reply_text:
Found one merge-blocking bug:

*P1 — `topTags` mutates the caller’s array* — `src/tags.js:10`
`tags.sort(...)` sorts in place, violating the non-mutating helper contract. In `sidebar`, the cloud is computed before the recent strip (`src/render.js:4–5`), so “recent” becomes ordered by popularity instead of the original input order.

Reproduced with `a:1, b:9, c:4`: the recent strip returns `[b, c, a]` instead of `[a, b, c]`.

*Recommended fix:* sort a copy (`[...tags].sort(...)`). Add regression tests asserting that `topTags` preserves its input and `sidebar` preserves recent-strip order.

All 4 existing tests pass, but none checks this behavior. No files changed.
